description: Defines the FigmaHeaderBar widget, a custom app bar for a Flutter app that matches a specific Figma header layout, including a back button, centered title, and optional right-side action icon.

classes.name: FigmaHeaderBar
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a custom application header bar that aligns with a Figma design, providing optional back navigation and trailing actions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the header bar, including back button, title, and optional trailing icon.
